description: Knee-up studio shot of a man in a charcoal boucle-wool overcoat, grey turtleneck and checked flat cap against a graduated charcoal-grey backdrop; subject centered, with plain dark space at the upper left and right.

Waist-up shot of a dark-haired woman in an olive-khaki cotton chore/overshirt jacket layered over a striped shirt, one hand in her hair, against a warm sand-beige studio wall; subject centered, with plain beige space above her head.

Tight low-key close-up of a man in a black zip hoodie with the hood up, half his face in shadow under warm side light on pure black; face centered, with deep black margins all around (bottom slightly cropped to remove a small chest patch).

Head-and-shoulders portrait of a dark-haired woman in a charcoal herringbone wool jacket with a tan shearling collar against a dark slate-grey backdrop; subject centered, with calm dark space in the top third.

Black-and-white, low-key three-quarter portrait of a seated man in a plain black crew-neck tee resting his cheek on his hand, against a mottled grey painted backdrop; subject fills the center of the frame.

Near full-length shot of a woman walking toward the camera in an oversized oatmeal double-breasted wool coat, white shirt and charcoal wide trousers, in a dark slate-grey concrete passage; subject centered, with dark calm areas left and right.

Young man in a long black wool coat and glasses leaning on a pale stone pillar beside a blue-grey roller shutter streaked with tree shadows; subject sits right of center (about 60-70% across) while the left half is a smooth, out-of-focus dark taupe-brown block ideal for white text.

Warm macro of weathered hands hand-stitching a pale grey linen seam with needle and cotton thread (square crop); the needle point sits just left of center, with thumbs framing the top-left and lower-right and soft brown shadow along the top.

Film-toned close-up of a camel brushed-wool tailored jacket on a black tailor's dummy with navy cardigan, white shirt, taupe tie and a cloth swatch card at the shoulder, against dark walnut paneling (square crop); garment fills the center-right, darker wood at the upper left.
Flat, evenly lit close-up of a dark charcoal heathered basketweave textile (wool-look) with no focal point, uniform edge to edge; suitable as a subtle tiled or cover background.
